q1_issues.issue: 'slightly' is a degree downtoner on the extent of the weakening, not a manner adverb; Degree lists 'slightly' as a level word, so slotting it as Manner records it under the wrong operator.
'briefly' is a duration/temporal adverb, not a manner adverb, so Manner is again a mis-slot rather than the licensed encoding.

Result is defined only for resultative secondary predicates (a state or motion result of an object); using it for the outcome infinitive 'to trade at 55.34/39' normalizes a surface 'to' into an inferred semantic relation, which the connective rules forbid.
(Past sk_trade_1) puts tense on a non-finite eventuality; the instruction set says a non-finite embedded eventuality carries no tense/status of its own and asserts nothing about occurrence.
'55.34/39' is a bid/ask quote pair - the '/39' half is silently dropped, so only one of the two stated values survives.
The modifier 'not far from its record low of 55.75' is dropped entirely: nothing relates the 55.34 level to the record low, so the sentence's comparison is unrecorded.

q2_gaps: degree/extent adverb modifying a VERB ('weakened slightly'): Degree is defined as (Degree <entity> <scale> <level>) on an entity plus an adjective scale, with no event-degree form
duration adverb with no measured amount ('briefly'): Measure e duration needs a number and unit, and Manner is for manner adverbs
result / outcome infinitive ('weakened ... to trade at 55.34/39'): the only 'to V' rule is the purpose infinitive (To / InOrderTo), which this is not - the currency does not weaken in order to trade
bare numeric price/quote with no unit word ('at 55.34', 'a record low of 55.75'): Measure requires a unit, so the value lands in a preposition-named oblique with a raw number as the object NP
bid/ask quote notation ('55.34/39') - a compressed two-value range
proximity / near-comparison between two values ('not far from X'): the comparative machinery has More / MoreBy / SameDegree / Degree but no small-difference or negated-distance relation
notes: The record_low compound decomposition (genus to 'low', noun modifier 'record' not exposed) and the Possession on 'its record low' are correct. The heads used are all defined operators or preposition-named obliques; the defects are mis-slotting and dropped content, not invented heads.
